name: app-store-compliance
description: Avoid common App Store and Google Play rejections. Open playbook and pre-submission guard with 124 documented rejection patterns and fixes, privacy manifest and Data safety checks, 112 tracked deadlines (EU AI Act, DSA, COPPA, age laws), and a skill for AI coding agents.
one_liner: A checklist-and-scanner playbook that catches the most common reasons Apple and Google reject apps before you submit, so you don't waste a whole review cycle.
buyer: A solo mobile app developer or small app studio who has been burned by a surprise App Store rejection and needs to ship on a deadline.
business_use_cases: An indie app developer runs the pre-submission guard before every release to avoid losing days to a rejection-and-resubmit cycle.
A mobile dev agency bakes it into their client delivery checklist as a quality guarantee that reduces support headaches.
A compliance consultant uses the tracked-deadline list (EU AI Act, DSA, COPPA, age laws) to offer regulatory-readiness audits to app studios.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'pre-submission audit' service for studios who want a human to double-check before they hit submit.
Build a hosted dashboard that tracks a studio's apps against live regulatory deadlines, sold as a subscription.

steal_this: Turn the playbook into a $20 'pre-submission checklist' Gumroad product for solo app developers, plus a paid 1:1 review add-on.
